items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my first show there was with Miguelito Valdés. He was who recommended me. It was he who asked that I be brought in to accompany him.

ctx.x: When I entered there it was in ’63. I was accompanying that year . . . my first show there was with Miguelito Valdés. He was who recommended me. It was he who asked that I be brought in to accompany him. That was in 1963. So I was there ten years.
And the group that accompanied those great artists who passed through here, through New York vía the Liborio consisted of whom?
